title: Task 1 - Student Grade Analysis System
description:
## Task Description
**Purpose**: Analyze student grades and summarize performance.
The system works with multiple **students**, each taking **four subjects**.
It calculates **student and subject averages**, identifies the **highest and lowest grades**,
and groups students into **performance levels**:
- **Excellent** (average ≥ 90)
- **Good** (80–89)
- **Average** (70–79)
- **Poor** (60–69)
- **Fail** (below 60)

It also **counts** how many students fall into each category.
Finally, it calculates the pass rate.

```text
=== STUDENT GRADE ANALYSIS ===

Student 0 Averages: 93.75 (Excellent)
Student 1 Averages: 83.50 (Good)
Student 2 Averages: 73.75 (Average)
Student 3 Averages: 63.50 (Poor)
Student 4 Averages: 75.00 (Average)
Student 5 Averages: 55.00 (Fail)
Student 6 Averages: 60.00 (Poor)

Subject Averages:
Subject 1: 79.29
Subject 2: 73.29
Subject 3: 61.29
Subject 4: 74.43

Highest Grade: 100
Lowest Grade: 89

Category Counts:
Excellent: 1
Good: 1
Average: 2
Poor: 2
Fail: 1

Pass Rate: 85.71%
Total Students Processed: 7
```

small: Check how totals are calculated inside loops.
Verify condition order in performance checks.
medium: Totals are overwritten instead of accumulated.
Some loops run too many or too few times.
Highest and lowest calculations only use part of the data.
big: Fix loop boundaries to avoid index errors.
Flatten all grades before finding min/max.
Use correct denominator for subject averages.
Ensure pass rate uses correct student count.
